query:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
                    SELECT DISTINCT e.ref_id
                    FROM products e
                    JOIN reviews r ON e.ref_id = r.category
                    WHERE e.category = 'electronics'
                      AND e.price > 50
                      AND r.rating IS NOT NULL
                    GROUP BY e.ref_id
                    HAVING COUNT(r.rating) >= 5
                      AND AVG(r.rating) < 3.0
                )
